goal: Publish a verified media-safe and fast public VII release across cards, search, home and business detail navigation.

intent_model.literal_request: Fix the illogical unavailable-image card, improve caching and image loading, make every important transition fly, publish and score it.
intent_model.implied_outcome: The user sees real content quickly and never waits for a supplier API or a broken image placeholder.
likely_rejections: Detail pages still wait on the supplier

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Remove avoidable blocking work and warm predictable destinations while preserving truthful data.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Measure representative cold and warm paths and report honest scores, not an unsupported perfect claim.

cognitive_flow.current_decision: Open a real result or detail without broken media or a blank wait
cognitive_flow.next_action: Continue browsing, search or return home

natural_destination: Public home, search, spa rail and business or event detail pages on desktop and mobile

facts.claim: Public business and event pages call liveSupplierPlaceDetail during render.
facts.evidence: app/business/page.tsx and both event place routes before this repair.

facts.claim: A one-image spa deal card renders an unavailable-image placeholder after the source fails.
facts.evidence: Supplied screenshot and PreviewCardGallery plus SpaPackageDeals source.

facts.claim: Business-depth routes intentionally open in a new tab and were excluded from SmartNavigationWarmup.

assumptions.claim: Accepted catalog details are sufficiently current for public rendering because supplier freshness is owned by the ingestion pipeline.
assumptions.validation: Master plan architecture plus production catalog origin and detail checks.

in_scope: Primary image prioritization and media-origin preconnect
invariants: No fabricated photo replaces a failed supplier photo
Accepted room and review detail remains visible
Slow-data and save-data visitors are not force-prefetched
No public card exposes an unavailable-image label

requirements.statement: A card whose complete real media set fails is withdrawn instead of rendering an empty image placeholder.
requirements.source: User request and VII media standard

requirements.statement: Public vacation and event detail pages render from the accepted platform snapshot without blocking on live supplier requests.
requirements.source: User performance request and master plan

requirements.statement: Business-depth destinations are warmed on user intent even though they intentionally open in a new tab.
requirements.source: User performance request and approved navigation rule

requirements.statement: Primary detail media receives high fetch priority and dominant supplier media origins are preconnected.
The exact tested release is published and verified on desktop and mobile with measured transition scores.

acceptance_checks.setup: A spa offer has one unreachable image.
acceptance_checks.action: Let the image exhaust its real media list.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The entire card leaves the rail and no unavailable-image copy or blank shell remains.

acceptance_checks.setup: A vacation and event supplier has an accepted detail snapshot.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Rooms, reviews and gallery data render without liveSupplierPlaceDetail in the page source.

acceptance_checks.setup: A pointer, focus or touch targets a business-depth link.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: App Router prefetch and same-origin force-cache document warmup execute unless Save-Data or 2G is active.

acceptance_checks.setup: A business detail page begins loading.
acceptance_checks.action: Inspect the primary gallery image and document head.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Primary media is eager/high priority and supplier origins are preconnected.

acceptance_checks.setup: The immutable candidate passes focused tests and build.
acceptance_checks.action: Publish once and poll with a bounded deadline.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The exact candidate reaches terminal success; an uncertain result is not retried blindly.

acceptance_checks.setup: Current public version and candidate identity are recorded.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The prior immutable public version remains known.

authorization_boundary: Code, testing and public deployment are authorized; no supplier write, booking, payment, message, secret or destructive operation is authorized.
